faq.a: Each product is a running system — backend, admin console, APIs and front-end — already built, tested and deployed. You configure it, apply your brand, connect your data and go live.

faq.q: How long until we are live?
faq.a: Between three days and three weeks depending on the product. A white-label vertical marketplace takes about three weeks.

faq.q: Whose brand does the customer see?
faq.a: Yours only. Domains, logo, colours, emails and documentation all ship under your brand name.

faq.q: Can we run more than one product together?
faq.a: Yes. Products share one identity layer (reID), one ledger on INFRA Network and one admin console, so they behave like a single platform.

faq.q: Can I list my own product?
faq.a: Yes. Have the ReSystem team build your master label, or upgrade an existing B2C product into one, and list it here for other businesses to license.

faq.q: Do we get the source code?
faq.a: Source access and self-hosting are available on enterprise agreements. Most customers stay on the managed deployment, which includes updates, monitoring and support.

faq.q: Can I invest in a product?
faq.a: Several products offer on-chain shares through the ReSystem Business Opportunity programme. Each product page links to its investment opportunity where one exists.
